description: This file contains the implementation of the RemoteInsertion interface, specifically the RemoteInsertionImpl class, which manages media insertion requests, handles broadcast receiver for media availability, and interacts with local proxy for media URI processing within the AnySoftKeyboard remote input method.

classes.name: RemoteInsertionImpl
classes.description: Implements media insertion request handling, broadcast receiver registration, and media URI proxying for remote input.

classes.name: MediaInsertionAvailableReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for media insertion availability broadcasts and triggers a reply callback.

classes.name: LocalProxyFunction
classes.description: An interface defining a method to proxy remote URIs to local URIs, used for dependency injection/testing.

methods.name: RemoteInsertionImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and local proxy, registering broadcast receiver.

methods.name: startMediaRequest
methods.description: Starts a media insertion request with specified MIME types, request ID, and callback.

methods.name: getMediaInsertRequestIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to request media insertion with specified MIME types and request ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disposes proxy, and unregisters broadcast receiver.

methods.name: onReply
methods.description: Handles the reply from media insertion, processes the URI, and invokes callback.
